title: 图画提示与现象概括
goal: 选择忠实于画面的描述；由画面概括相关社会现象。

points.label: 选择忠实于画面的描述
由画面概括相关社会现象

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 图画提示与现象概括的教学范围、知识点及写作小测规格

body.p: 图画的文字说明给出人物、物品和动作。描述句只写看得见的信息。概括句说明这些信息反映的现象。推测出来的动机不能当作画面事实。

body.box: A passenger places a suitcase on an empty seat while another passenger stands beside it.

body.p: places 和 stands 是动作，由此可以概括出占用公共座位的现象。故意羞辱他人是画面没有给出的动机，不写进描述。

steps.d: 写清谁在做什么、对什么做。A passenger places a suitcase on a seat 不能缩成只列出 suitcase 的物品清单。
从动作之间的关系概括问题。有人站着，行李却占着座位，可以概括为公共空间的使用问题。一幅画只说明这一个场景，不说明所有乘客。
评论针对画面中的行为或安排。A discussion of keeping seats available 回应了占座问题。行李的品牌与这一问题无关。

cards.title: 画面与评论对象
rows: 描述画面
At a refill point, one student leaves a bottle under a running tap while talking to a friend.
A student talks to a friend while water continues running into the unattended bottle.
只写看到的动作，不写学生故意浪费。
描述画面
At a stairway, two people hold a banner across the entrance while others wait below.
Two people hold a banner across a stairway entrance while several others wait below.
保留持横幅者与等待者。
概括问题
The bottle is full, but the tap is still running beside the distracted student.
The scene draws attention to water waste caused by failing to monitor a running tap.
概括为没有看管水龙头造成的浪费。
概括问题
The banner blocks the stairway entrance, leaving the people below unable to pass.
The scene shows how an activity can interfere with access to a shared passage.
只谈这次活动，不说所有宣传活动有害。
确定评论对象
The overflowing bottle remains under the tap while the conversation continues beside it.
The essay can discuss attending to resource use during ordinary activities in shared facilities.
评论资源使用行为。
确定评论对象
The people below wait for the banner holders to clear the stairway entrance.
The essay can discuss keeping shared routes accessible when organizing activities in public spaces.
评论通行与活动安排。

body.box: Picture description: A person at a self-service checkout has placed a basket across the neighboring machine. Another shopper stands in front of that machine holding a small purchase. The first person is scanning items at a different machine. No caption gives either shopper's thoughts or explains why the basket was placed there.

body.p: 画面上看得到的关系：篮子占着相邻的机器，另一名顾客在等。描述要写出两名顾客。概括可以落在共享设备能否使用上。

body.box:
Which statement is supported?
1. A shopper places a basket across another checkout while a second shopper waits there.
2. A shopper blocks another checkout to punish a customer who arrived late.
3. Both shoppers are using the same machine to scan their purchases together.
4. A basket has been removed from the neighboring machine so another shopper can begin.

body.p: 第一项写出了动作和对象。第二项加了画面没有给出的动机。

body.box: The scene suggests that personal use of space can restrict other people's access to shared equipment.

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 虚构动机
The shopper blocks the machine because the waiting customer previously refused to help.
画面没有显示先前的冲突。
遗漏主体
A basket and a machine are visible in the checkout area of the shop.
漏掉了等待的顾客和占用关系。
动作倒置
The waiting shopper removes the basket and begins scanning the items at that machine.
把站立等待写成操作机器。
过度概括
Every shopper prefers preventing others from using machines rather than sharing the checkout area.
一幅画面说明不了 every。

items.stem: Picture: A visitor photographs a notice while another reads it. Which description preserves both actions?
options: One visitor takes a photograph while another visitor reads the same notice.
Both visitors photograph the notice before either of them begins reading it.
One visitor reads the notice while the other visitor removes it from display.
Both visitors read the notice because neither has a device for taking photographs.
items.why: photographs 和 reads 是两个人各自的动作。第一项把两个动作都保留了下来。

items.stem: Picture: A cyclist leaves a bicycle across a ramp; a wheelchair user waits below. Which comment fits?
options: The scene proves that wheelchair users never use alternative routes through public spaces.
The scene raises the issue of keeping access routes clear for people using wheelchairs.
The scene shows that cyclists need ramps more than people who use wheelchairs.
The scene shows that cyclists leave bicycles across every public ramp they use.
items.why: 依据是 across a ramp 和 waits below：自行车挡住坡道，轮椅使用者过不去。第二项由此概括出保持通道畅通的问题。

items.stem: Picture: A diner returns an unopened snack while a worker points to a collection box. Which description fits?
options: The worker opens the snack while the diner points to a nearby collection box.
The diner leaves the snack on the floor while the worker moves the box.
The diner hands back an unopened snack as the worker indicates a collection box.
The worker refuses the snack while the diner closes the nearby collection box.
items.why: returns 是 diner 的动作，points 是 worker 的动作。第三项用 hands back 和 indicates 改写，人物和对象都没变。

items.stem: Picture: Everyone at a meeting looks at a phone while a speaker points to a proposal. Which comment is supported?
options: The speaker's proposal has already been accepted by everyone attending the meeting.
The phones prove that the speaker's proposal contains no information worth discussing.
The participants have all been instructed by the speaker to check their messages.
The scene highlights competing attention between personal devices and a shared discussion.
items.why: 参会者看手机，发言人指着提案，两边的注意力不在一处。第四项概括的正是这一点。

groups.text: Picture description: At a public drinking fountain, a person washes muddy shoes directly over the drinking outlet. Two people holding cups wait nearby. A sign identifies the fountain as drinking water. The picture gives no information about the person's intentions or about any other washing facilities in the area.

items.stem: Which comment stays within the visual evidence?
options: Using a drinking outlet for dirty shoes can interfere with its intended shared use.
People holding cups have requested that shoes be washed before they collect water.
The person washing shoes intends to stop all nearby residents from drinking the water.
The scene proves that there are no other washing facilities anywhere in the area.
items.why: 标牌写明 drinking water，有人却在出水口上 washes muddy shoes。两种用途冲突，即第一项。

items.stem: Complete a description retaining the action and its object.
items.why: washing muddy shoes 写出了这个人的动作。拿着杯子的是旁边等候的两个人。

groups.text: Picture description: At a community exhibition, a visitor holds a tablet high above a display label. The tablet blocks the view of two children standing behind the visitor. The visitor is taking a photograph of the display. The picture provides no information about the visitor's intentions or the children's feelings.

items.stem: Which sentence accurately describes the scene?
options: A visitor's raised tablet obstructs two children's view of an exhibition label.
Two children raise a tablet while a visitor reads the exhibition label behind them.
A visitor lowers a tablet so two children can photograph the exhibition label.
Two children photograph a display while a visitor stands behind them holding a label.
items.why: 依据是 The tablet blocks the view of two children standing behind the visitor。第一项用 obstructs 改写了这一遮挡关系。

items.stem: Which issue is most directly supported?
options: Exhibitions should ban photography because children cannot see the labels.
Photography in shared displays requires attention to other visitors' ability to see.
The visitor deliberately prevents children from learning because the display is unsuitable.
Every use of a tablet makes it impossible for anyone to enjoy an exhibition.
items.why: 依据是 blocks the view。拍照挡住了别人的视线，由此概括出拍照时要顾及他人观看，即第二项。第三项加了画面没有给出的动机。

items.stem: Complete the description of the visible obstruction.
items.why: blocks 对应画面里的遮挡。improves 意思相反。

items.stem: Complete a relevant comment about the behavior.
items.why: able to see 回应孩子们看不到展品的问题。unable 意思相反。

groups.text: Picture description: In a shared kitchen, one resident leaves food scraps inside a sink. Another resident holds a saucepan beside the sink, waiting to wash it. A clear sign asks users to put food scraps in a nearby container. The illustration does not show who originally installed the sink or made the sign.

items.stem: Which description retains the relevant people and actions?
options: One resident places food scraps in the container while another washes a saucepan.
The waiting resident installs a sink while another resident removes the nearby sign.
One resident leaves scraps in the sink while another waits with a saucepan.
Both residents wash saucepans while placing food scraps in the container together.
items.why: leaves food scraps 和 waiting to wash 是两个住户各自的动作。第三项把两个动作都保留了下来。

items.stem: Which comment follows from the picture?
options: The container is unavailable, so residents must put food scraps into the shared sink.
The resident who made the sign should clear the scraps out of the sink.
The waiting resident deliberately caused the obstruction to avoid washing the saucepan.
Following shared disposal arrangements helps keep facilities usable for the next person.
items.why: 标牌要求把剩菜放进 nearby container。有人没照做，下一个人就用不了水槽，即第四项。

items.stem: Complete a faithful description of the waiting resident.
items.why: 住户手里拿的是 a saucepan。a sign 是背景里的标牌，不是要洗的东西。

items.stem: Complete the comment targeting the depicted issue.
items.why: ready for others 回应等候者要用水槽的需求。unavailable to others 意思相反。
